items.title: Democrats projected to win the House and Senate in the US midterms
items.tldr: The BBC and NPR report that Democrats won both chambers of Congress on November 3; President Trump said he would respect the outcome.

items.title: Supreme Court hears Catholic preschools' challenge to Colorado's nondiscrimination rule
items.tldr: At oral argument, SCOTUSblog and NPR said a majority of justices seemed inclined to back Catholic preschools seeking an exemption from Colorado's nondiscrimination rule; no ruling yet.
